# 0097 — Fixture: a Proposed ADR

Status: Proposed — awaiting owner sign-off (fixture, for the licence gate's tests)

A stand-in ADR that names the packages a fixture exemption covers but has not been accepted, so an exemption citing it fails the rule that the cited ADR must be Accepted. Its status is the first non-blank line after its title and nowhere else. The blocks below each quote or hide an Accepted line, and none of them may count, even once the status line above is deleted. The licence gate's tests also move each of them above the status line, where it must not count either.

Packages it names: `fixture-gpl-lib`, `@fixture/ui`.

Status: Accepted — owner decision, YYYY-MM-DD
